text: This game is genuinely addictive in every aspect. Little to no ads, fun gameplay, variety of events, and vibrant graphics. I have a lot of games on my phone, but the second I downloaded this one I stopped playing any others! The lack of ads is just so refreshing. There is a lot of pop-ups for in-game purchases, but they're easy to ignore. The gameplay is simple in theory, but keeps you hooked by introducing new ingredients, new cooking stations, and different combinations. Please don't change!

It's more of a thinly veiled cash grab than most games in this genre, and that is saying a lot. They are just too stingy with the energy, you barely get 5 minutes of gameplay. It's designed to be instantly addictive but it just gets frustrating, never satisfying. You don't get to make any choices along your journey, so the narrative arc isn't fun At some point the challenges get so hard it just feels like punishment. Why not throw some easy levels in between!? I should have known better!

I am at level 186 so I've been playing for a couple of years now. I enjoyed the game immensely and have spent quite a bit of money on it. But over the last 3 months and last couple updates, there has been noticeable changes .... Many perks have been taken away, the generators have to recharge more quickly than before, for many orders it takes a couple of days to complete unless you spend money. I will not support a developer who blatantly forces users into spending money to continue playing!

I'm not a huge fan of this game. I like merge games and find completely challenges fun, but the complexity of the generators and then cooking ingredients in this game gets to be a bit much to keep track of. The bored is also too small to work on a bunch of orders at once and if you end up with extra ingredients after a order is completed you end up needing to get rid of them to free space up instead of saving till later. Generators take too long to cool down too.

Game needs improvement. you get to a certain point where all orders are super high level items and it makes game play progress slowly. generators don't get phased out you just add to them so the board is half full of them and the equipment. game was fun at first but now it's stalled and without spending a ton of money on gems it's hard to get further in.

Nothing like the ads. I just want to merge cooking/food items... Is that too much to ask?! In the ads, I'm merging similar items that are already there until the board gets empty. This game is more like making a generator in order to merge. Why is the ad and the game different, and why do I need a storyline? And, of course, you got to wait if you want to generate items... It's so unfortunate.

This is (or was, until the latest updates) my favorite merge game. It's actually addictive and fun to play. However, the latest updates have made the game worse for me, less ads to offer you free in-game items, which causes me to play for less time, and makes me less likely to spend money on the game. Also hate the giant notification informing you "these items cannot be combined" if you accidentally drag the wrong ingredient to a cooking station.

This is a fun game. Progressive merging. Good bit of challenge, no forced ads, no need to spend to enjoy playing and progressing. The purchases available are reasonably priced if you want to buy and win extra stuff in events. Does not lock you into daily play outside of trying to challenge the events so you can play at your own pace. The energy build up is slow so it's more the type of game you revisit 10 to 15 minutes at a time, save up the extra goodie boxes for days you want to play longer.

I'm so disappointed because I don't get ads to get more energy (which I want). My friend is able to get ahead and enjoy since she has the ads. I tried troubleshooting several times, and nothing helps. I also reached out via email to the help desk. I've received no follow up. The game could be fun but it's been really impossible to complete orders without at least a boost of energy from ads. I'm not sure it is worth my time.

90 days of playing, thanks to Fetch, I think the game is below meh. It became redundant. Energy is the one thing you need to play, and the Merge Cooking overseers are beyond stingy with free energy. Oh,100 every few hours or whatever, this is great, but as you progress in the game, you realize the customers will only ask for items that take 4 to 500+ to spawn. The cost of energy is overpriced, and in 3 months of multiple daily play, I never once finished one single album. Fishy. Uninstall.

Found this after playing a newer version of this exact game but found this one much better. Love the sorting feature and that I can play an ad if desired. Because the ad is a choice, I dont mind watching them. I do not like where they place buttons on pop up ads that almost always ends with you clicking the button and them trying to force a transaction. if one does not have the right security, they will buy things unintentionally. Had to add...I really dont like that you can't turn hints off.

After I made a purchase, everything that I could watch an ad for disappeared. Now I have to spend gems to receive items. I could watch an ad to get an energy chest, or double an achievement prize, but now, nothing. Why have you changed it so now I have to spend gems to receive items that used to be free? Because I had made a purchase? That's a complete rip off

honestly love this game! yes you get a limited energy, but going in during my breaks and lunch I'm able to really keep up with this and enjoy the leveling up. You get gems when you hit levels and extra energy when you complete 3 tasks daily which isn't hard. One of the best merge games I've played. I downloaded it to hit certain levels to make money on a different app but ended up keeping it because it's honestly just fun to play leisurely. I've never had pop ups maybe it's the device I'm using.

The game was challenging in the beginning, but after level 40...it started getting impossible. I've been stuck on level 48 for 3 days and still haven't finished. The requirements to make an ingredient are too high. After you make the ingredients, some orders require those ingredients to make another to fulfill orders. Will be deleting app.

The game play is fun, a bit repative at times, but still fun. My only complaint is not keeping the food truck around VERY much. It really helps clearing up your board and helping with ingredients to your at times highly repeating quests. It would be nice to actually complete an event without money, which would be nice too(since you sprinkled in copious amounts of ads already).

Most recently the game is not generating an ingredient that's needed to complete a recipe. I've cycled through over 150 lightening bolts and that generator is generating everything but that ingredient that's needed. This is way beyond random and more like glitched out designed to purposely impede play. I think I've spent my last dime on this game. Kudos to you, you got quite a lot before this.

I love the mobile game Merge Cooking for its level up and bonus rewards that make continuous gameplay possible and I do not have to wait hours for energy. (I thought I left an awesome review, but I guess it did not save. Sorry game developer). back to my review, This merge game is awesome for its ability to be played without WiFi. I do not find many games like that and being that I can play this one everywhere without WiFi is the coolest. Thank you game developer - 💋

It keeps deleting my progress. like just now when I finally reached a high level item and put it on the grill with a 45 minute timer. When I came back an hour later to move on, not only was there nothing on the grill, but the high level item wasn't even there, and I had to remerge a bunch to get it again, and now I have to rewait all that time. This is ridiculously unacceptable.

The game is really fun and engaging. Challenging, but doesn't require the micro-transactions to play. My only real complaint is I feel like I need a pop-up blocker at times. Sometimes 5 'offers' in a row have to be closed before I can just play the game, which is just excessive. More than 6 months later, I am still playing the game. But I can't go up to 5 stars, because from opening the app to getting to play the game, it take 2 minutes of having to click though all the dang pop ups.

I have put a lot of time into this game, like 108 hours and am on level 59, and I have had to give up on it unfortunately, unless I was to pay a decent chunk of money for more storage space. My storage is full, and my board is full. I only have 10 spaces without generators. It makes the game impossible to play and not fun to play at all, which is unfortunate.

This is a fun freemium game; it can be played for free. However, it baits you into spending money to complete events, and right when you're about to complete an event and win the big prize, the event will suddenly end early without warning. I've had it happen twice now, and customer service is a joke. I'm done putting my few dollars a month into an unfair and rigged game. *IF* I keep playing, I won't be spending money on it. Two stars because it's fun and can be played free, but it'll screw you.

really fun game. pretty addicting. ive played other versions and they are all similar. the only downside i would say that I wish the further you got you could collect more energy while idle. while I appreciate that there are zero ads, maybe also allowing you to watch a video to get more energy. there are a ton of ways to purchase it, if you can afford that. started playing because I use fetch. I definitely get alot of points through there for completing levels which is great.

This is a fun game but it is VERY aggressive with trying to get you to pay to play. There are constant pop-ups encouraging you to buy things and the game is clearly designed to limit your game play when you won't. There is no clear explanation anywhere regarding how long generators take to recharge or how many items a generator at a certain level will make before it needs to recharge. It seems arbitrary and based on what items you need at the time. It gets frustrating and unenjoyable very fast.

this is not a bad game But it's expensive and you don't get much merging done before the clock comes on and then you can't click on it for quite a while. also I shouldn't have to pay more and more diamonds for the same amount of play rods. I have to pay 10 20 40 60 80 then 160. for a 100 play, each time I pay. That's a rip off. when you guys stop the greed I will change my star rate. making it two stars only cuz they're good at replying to my review. The game is still expensive. lol.

This is the best merge game I've found, and I've played a lot of merge games lol the mechanic of having to cook/process food, that some foods can either merge or be tapped for new foods, getting energy from completing tasks, its all amazing and fun! The longer I play a game, the more likely I am to spend money, which is something some devs forget when they impose tight energy mechanics. edit: FIVE events just started at the same time?? are you for real?? dropped to one star... thats too much!

It's a merge game. If you understand the genre, you know exactly what you will get. It suffers from the same consequences as every game in the market. Namely, exponential growth of needed materials, and imposed wait times via generator cooldowns and energy limits. It is an algorithmically designed 'game' to separate your money from your wallet. As are most games on the store.

Might raise the review if the problem ever gets fixed. It's a great way to kill time but I'm so sick of the fact that I lose progress almost every time I close the app. I'll make matches until I'm out of energy and get close to my end goal of a certain level of item, close out and wait for more energy, only to open back up to see that item is levels lower than it was when I closed it. Do better

It would be fun but it's hard to progress. You can only play for like 15 mins at a time. Everything gets harder, you have to click a lot more, but they never give you more energy or diamonds. They want 50 💎 for an item that you can then sell for like two 🪙, which is nothing. Baskets give you 14 items (then u wait) which you then have to merge 150x to complete 1 dish, but you only get 100 energy. You're stuck forever waiting and constantly losing side games to the people who spend $. Not fun.

Update 05/2026 didn't change a thing, so they are not actively listening to the reviews. Update: Gave it another try, but renewal power stops at 100 now. Never goes higher, so you have to keep PAYING or waiting. ***Pick ANOTHER MERGE GAME. - Beware, you reach the higher levels, meaning you should be getting more expensive food output, but instead, the output of food drops down to the lowest levels again, and you have to pay more and more to reach the next level. Total cash grab. Beware

I loved the game but I really wish you would stop using dynamic pricing. it doesn't say you do but you most definitely do. I have bought some energy pack it started at 2.99 and now it's at 6.99 and I haven't been playing the game that long everyday I get a popup from in game purchase and the pricing keeps going up. buying a pack here and there for 2.99 or 3.99 ok but some now are 10.99 or 12.99 for the same value. it's a bit much. the only one that the price hasn't changed is the reg diamonds.

DO NOT EVER PURCHASE ANYTHING THROUGH THIS GAME. THEY WILL TAKE AWAY ALL YOUR DAILY PERKS. I've been playing this game for 5+ years. I've had to start over twice from switching phones & the info not transferring properly. I reached out to them through email & never got a response. I dealt with it & moved forward. Recently, I gave in and purchased a few extra, temporary perks that were very short-lived. Now, the game is trying to charge me for everything I used to get by watching an ad. Uninstal

DISCLAIMER: I was paid for playing this game, but this review is neither sponsored nor paid. Directly before playing this, I played Merge Cruise, and this is clearly superior. If nothing else, it's entirely stable and the graphics are much better, I had no problem with either. That said, it's also entirely too complicated, and I just don't get the draw of merge game gameplay in the first place.

I really wanted to love this game, I even purchased a game pack but that was a HUGE mistake! This game got so much slower and WAY LESS FUN once I bought this add on! It was like the whole experience slowed down and I stopped gaining levels or making any progress. Ive been trying to revoke the purchase to see if the game goes back to being fun but I can't. I really liked this game UNTIL I SPENT MONEY ON IT THEN IT then it stopped being fun and kept trying to get me to spend more.

This game was fun now it's boring. so you could used to watch an ad. either a mixed up go faster or get another treasure chest of life and they took all that away and now I don't really want to play it anymore cuz it was so much more fun when you have the option to speed stuff up or get an extra bonus or build stuff quicker but now since you can't it's boring and it's slow I would no longer recommend

I enjoy the game but once you make a purchase they take away the opportunity to watch ads to gain rewards. Not cool. Update regarding your message which I can't reply to: Thank you for your response. I was referring to the "Road to Treasure" which has the option to buy the rewards, but it comes free if you watch ads. Seems like the option is taken away once you make an app purchase. Players must purchase rewards, but both options should be available.

I've played this game for awhile now. im finding that once you get to the higher levels its very difficult to get anywhere. Coins earned from completing orders is disproportionate to the energy consumed making those orders. 350 coins for something that takes nearly 700 energy is a joke. Im probably going to stop playing because the pay offs just arent worth it. So be warned. They get you hooked and then you have to pay to play.

Fun BUT.. it definitely does NOT give enough energy for the tasks its asking to be completed. I'm only at stage 14 and some tasks require over 1000 energy just for 1 item in an order because the game will force you to waste your energy. When the game only gives 100 energy at a time and takes almost 3 hours to refill once its gone, its next to impossible to complete WITHOUT paying money for energy or waiting several days to complete 1 item. definitely considering uninstalling. not fun anymore.

I'm a merge addict, have had DOZENS of games, keeping 3/25 so far. Maybe this one?! It's not the "same ole merge game", you combine and create dishes, not simply merge the same stuff nonstop. I suggest more ways 2 get power ups, moves, etc and there are fewer low cost pkgs than most games. I didn't expect the 3 options to be 5.99, 9.99, 14.99.. that a big deal to ppl. Most have $1 & $2 picks.. but buy repeatedly so it works. I'd play 24/7 if I had moves but not $5 pkg w/ no gems inc.. just moves

Yes I like the game. My issue is the higher the level I've gotten the less rewards I've gotten but takes way more energy to get something like a watermelon. If you need sea salt good luck! I was getting 25 energy per level up now I'm only getting 15 but to make a watermelon it takes over 2500 energy! It was fun but I'm done now even if I buy energy it's not enough to finish a level plus it is super boring working on only one thing just to get to like a watermelon.

Great game. I just wish it was easier to get energy. 5 stars still!.. edited to 2 stars because of the Wagashi and Sakura level.. I needed higher level grain for other customers, but it kept giving me common beans trying to force me to make wagashi and sakura 1st... it's really annoying.. edited to 1 star. I wish it was less... it takes way too much to make wagashi and sakura without spending money!! I'm extremely disappointed! It's very annoying!

Update: Can we please get more recipes that use milk/sugar/honey? Way too many milks produced, taking up valuable space. I love the option to watch ads for additional energy and to pop item bubbles! Also, being able to combine +8 cards was definitely needed; my board and inventory look much better now. THANK YOU developers for listening!

They scam you like crazy on this game. pop ups to buy gems for ridiculous amounts like $14.99 while you're tapping and playing the game that will take money from your account if you don't quickly tap the cancel button. also if you mistakenly tap the "buy bubble" button which is super close to the "break bubble" button, it instantly uses what little gems you have, to buy an item you don't want. it doesn't ask "are you sure you want to buy this bubble?" like other games, it just takes it.

Among merge mobile games, this is one of the better options. You can tell that there's production value behind it since it's not bad to look at and is shiny in a non-generic way. The gameplay is what you're used to if you've played games like Merge Harbor or Haunted Merge, but there are some nice additional mechanics to spice things up without that are interesting and pretty intuitive to grasp.

I agree with most of the other players of this game. The amount of energy needed to merge and fulfill orders, does not match the energy amount. It runs out quick and replenishes real slow, specially with some of the orders requiring quite a bit of it. and the generators? They don't help much with regenerating anything. I'm thinking the amount of energy you start with has to be increased when you reach a certain level to match the energy required to complete orders.

the game is good.. but I don't like how you have to merge 50,000 items to get one item. it takes way too long. it gets boring!then you have to spend real money for diamonds or energy, to get items needed and that costs more money! this game is a gimmick to get money.. it shouldn't take all your energy to get 1 item from idk how many merges.. other than that it's ok, no storyline..

I can't say whether the game is worth playing or not as the "helping hand" prevents me from making any choices of my own in the game. There needs to be an option to turn it off. if I have to try to stay ahead of it for much longer, I will erase this app and give it one star. if the annoyance goes away, I will add another star if the game is fun, but enough is enough, the hand can go! Make a button to turn it off, please!!! update: I'm actually just going to delete this game.

If I want a certain item (ex: Quail), the poultry portion is already a rare item, but I think they make it even more rare and it takes forever to get the higher level items. Same with milk products or coffee. But if I have to get the normal items like higher level drink items, the generator will churn out more milk and coffee products.

I REALLLY like this game and agree with other 5 star reviews. I appreciate that they heard me and responded to my other review. Here's what I love about the game. I get long game play time because I earn energy easily and can watch commercials for more. i love that i can organize the board with a click. the side quest are also fun to try and complete. there are some that are too hard like I haven't completed a card collection yet. a few others but I enjoy building and serving most!

Fun game, but can you guys play nice with other apps please? YouTube picture-in-picture used to pause every time I opened Merge Cooking (the only game that I play that does this), but a quick unpause fixed the issue. After this new update, the picture-in-picture is paused any time I click anything in the game. Please fix this so I can give you all a 5!

UPDATE: I saw your notice as to the audio issue fix. Thanks so much for this! I'm back to my podcasts and playing now. This game is really cute and fun so THANK YOU developers!!! Really great game but now I can't have my other apps in the background. I like listening to podcasts while playing (since I'm usually playing for a while) but now YouTube shuts off as soon as this app comes on. I'm still playing the game, can't you devs let me have my podcasts? Will give higher reviews if you fix this.

Fun match & merge game! The graphics are great! I enjoy matching & filling all of the orders. There's never enough energy though. I'd like to be able to watch ads for a large amount of energy. Some items have too many steps to get to the end item you need which uses a lot of your energy.

Your update forces YouTube to stop playing when I'm in the game. Even once it's fully loaded and I'm on the board, if I pull down my notification bar and press play on YouTube, once I drag the notification bar back up, YouTube stops playing again. It didn't used to do that, what the heck did you do in the update?? Please fix it Edit: IT'S FIXED!!! HOORAY!!! 😍

good but some things are annoying. please stop forcing me to go to the event page when the new one starts. I clicked the X when the pop up came up so why are you holding the game hostage until I visit the page. turn that off, I'm here for fun not collections or things like that. not knocking it but please stop forcing me. I will raise my review if this is changed.

it's got good graphics but the way to find out how u get items it doesnt explain it very easily my daughter had a hard time and she's in 7th grade taking honors classes. she's asking me and really even I can't figure it out so explaining things would be a good idea here when you get to the making of items for people. other then that it's a GREAT GAME, wish I got 200 lightening bolts a charge max not 100 sorry im a bit greedy but I enjoy playing too and I go thru the 100 so fast cuz it's so fun

I'd give it a 3.5 out of 5. It's a good game overall. My issues with it is that it forced participation in the "mini-games"/events. Like, I shouldn't be forced to keep closing the screen for building a burger (a race) every time I open the game. Nor should I have to go through the tutorial stage of another event that I, again, want no parts of to begin with. 4/14/26: My issue was never fixed. In fact it was made worse. Why am I having to close NINE pop ups- IN GAME POP UPS just to play?!

They like to steal your energy. When you opt to watch a video, it shows the video ( worth 25 energy) and when the ad is done it will say that there was a problem with the video, but here's 15 energy for your trouble. Mind numbingly repetitious. EDIT: I deleted the game. Too much trouble and there are much better games out there.

I am addicted to this game. It can be frustrating when you have an item you have to merge like so many times to get the final product, it takes days sometimes to pass a level. But I do enjoy the game, just wish they would have unlimited amounts of ads you can choose to watch if you want more energy or want to keep playing. edited review since last update: most of the time, after watching a 30 second ad, the energy reward doesn't work. also, the game has been taking me completely kicking me out

I have played a lot of merge games, but this has been one of my favorites. you merge to make the ingredients and then cook them in stations like a grill, oven, prep table, mixer, etc. the different recipes is where this game shines. a normal ingredient like milk can be used in dozens of dishes. The main thing I have an issue with is the price of monthly subscriptions. There is an event you can buy for a reasonable price, but the main ad skip package is ridiculously expensive.

WAAAYYYYY too many in game, game related popups that try to make me purchase items. For instance, every time I double click (because the mechanics aren't 100% perfect, but they ain't bad) and i run out of energy, a popup for me to purchase thousands of energy points comes up. Every. Single. Time. Why not just show me ads?? Also, this app forces background music (e.g. Spotify) to stop. Please delete this feature.

I loved the game at first, merge games tend to keep me entertained, but then it's like the endless tapping, as well as the cost (both time and money) become "eh". I like it, but it becomes too much and that makes me bored. You have to wait too long for energy and when I have to go thru 400 energy for ONE item....yeah, no thanks.

Fun to play. One thing — as we get deeper in the game (I'm on the Macaron restaurant, lvl 48) I suggest increasing the max energy. Currently, it stops recharging energy upon reaching 100. When you get deep in the game, and the game requires much higher-level items, it can take a really long time to even fulfill one order when it stops recharging at 100. I suggest gradually increasing that number as we advance through levels and restaurants.

highly addictive game especially if you are a completionist & competitive. There's no storyline but it does have time based objectives. Which brings me to my rating. If you've ever played a merging game you know some items will take more effort to get to, which ultimately makes you spend more coins. That's fine but if I have purchased the coins and the game only spits out 4-5 items per hour to complete an object because coins dont work for this particular thing (painting)thats a problem.

This is fun! Until I run out of energy, or a generator quits after only producing a few items. I'd lie to see you let generators last longer. Update 2/10/26. I'm uninstalling. At level 74, the recipe for "rice flour dough", is insane! Trying to make 1 items, so far, has cost over 700 individual items! and that's not counting what it takes to just make the rice flour for each dough batch. I've spent money in the game because it's fun. But this is where I leave.

I love the game but seems to be more like having to spend money. Not enough of free rewards and boost energy. It can take you all day or two to collect all the items. This is not it and probably will end up deleting the game. Costing too much money! Also, if you are rewarded a +8 or +16 card for moves, it should not come off the initial moves you have as well. I do not call this a reward..POINTLESS to give if that is the case!

I'm glad you brought back the option to get more energy chests and items through watching ads! I'll admit I was a little disappointed to see them missing, but I'm so excited to see they're back because I love this game! some of the dishes can be challenging, but I think it's fun to create dishes to complete orders instead of what I've seen in a majority of merge games where you're simply gathering items for orders. the cooking aspect makes it feel more involved, and I like that a lot!

Game was great to begin with. Now the watch an ad option for the different quests, road to treasure, bubble items, etc are gone. It only either offers if you want to spend gems or by using actual money. Sent an email asking questions about why the ad options are gone and got nowhere. With no option to watch ads for additional items, energy, and quests it makes it impossible to reach any goals and you run out of board and storage space to reach higher level items without having to delete others.

the game is fun, I do enjoy it. and I hate to say I have spent a sizable amount of money playing it in the last few weeks since I was sick and had nothing to do. My biggest issue is it takes time to merge and cook and then my items just disappear. then I have to start over and spend more energy and time. this has happened at least 6 times on the last few days. I am getting very frustrated and there ks noone to talk to about getting my items back. honestly

Eh, you've played one merge game, you've played them all, and this one isn't particularly special. There is a unique cooking/mixing mechanic which is neat, but that's really about it. The "story", if you can call it that, is either cringe or non-existent. Growth is slow, you get locked out of progress very rapidly, there are very few freebies, and the game almost demands purchases - if you accidentally tap a generator that just ran out, you'll get a pop-up to spend. Don't install.

Was not surprised to find that other players were experiencing the same frustrations about the energy regeneration and level completion time frames. I, thankfully, only played this game for 3 days before I realized the cash grab aspect. In order for people to want to spend, the game must be much more compelling, and this misses that mark in many ways. You literally can't do anything in game while waiting, the idle time is boring. It'd be nice for relevant mini games outside of the cash grab.

Fun game but I really dislike the energy and generator recharge built into this game. If I want to keep playing, just let me play! I can log on and completely blow throw my generators and/or energy in less than a couple minutes. Then you have to wait for hours to be able to do another solid push. Also the amount of purchasable packs they throw in your face is ridiculous. Basically to progress steadily or win most events requires dropping money on this, which I'm not willing to do.

Not what the ad showed. maybe it's better in later levels, but I did not sign up for a game about clicking on two matching items. I'm incredibly bored of merge games like this so was excited to get an ad for a game that was different. plus the story is unnecessary and makes the game drag on even more than the boring levels. if you like basic point and click merge games I'm sure this is fine. it's just the false advertising that's frustrating

Every time they have an event you are forced through an event tutorial. It is so annoying. I can't wait till my time is up on having to play this game for another app because this game sucks with forcing tutorials on you all the time and constantly having their stuff to buy popping up. Can't even get on and play the game in peace without all their pop ups. I'd literally rather watch ads.

DONT MAKE ANY PURCHASES IN THIS GAME!!! Once you purchase anything (no matter how small) all the ad-supported freebies disappear. I was getting an extra like 150-400 energy every day through the Road to Treasures. You watch up to like 10 different ads and get energy and gems and pop bubbles for items etc. Google search "Merge Cooking ad-supported content gone after making a purchase 2026" LAME.

I've been playing this game for a couple months. I find it enjoyable, but I've learned not to participate in the Munch's order or Dessert Dash because it's just a way to suck your energy with rewards not really worth it. I like that you are not constantly bombarded with ads; however, the option to watch ads for energy would be nice. Supposedly some people have it. I have never seen it. Also, it would be nice to see how much time is left on a generator recharge.

I do enjoy this version of the many cooking apps I've tried, BUT the one big downfall with this one, which I consider to be pretty significant in my eyes, is that it doesn't show you the time left on generators or how much longer before a machine is done cooking your food. I imagine they do this on purpose to try and rake in more money from the people like me who are inpatient and I for one find this quite upsetting, mostly because I admittedly turn to these games to stay away from real gambling

Addictive and so fun! I honestly enjoy playing this game so much. Even spending a little bit of cash for the extra stuff isn't awful. However, one suggestion about inventory. There's 2 inventory areas. The Generator Inventory only stores the recipe books & Specialty Generators. It'd be so helpful to have ALL Generator items moved into this area. Like the cooking and producing items, too. Otherwise, this game is incredible!

After this latest update, there are no more refills on energy or generators by watching ads. Also, you can't pop bubbles containing lower level items by watching ads. It is all diamonds or nothing. There's no point in spending a minute running through 100 energy, then waiting a couple of hours to play again. The game is now ruined. I'll be looking for a new merge game to play
